tldr: Mars in Scorpio: action is intense, strategic, and deeply focused.
body: With Mars in Scorpio, Mars is at home, so drive moves through depth, endurance, and the willingness to confront what others avoid. Energy becomes powerful when trust and purpose are clear.

challenge: Control, obsession, revenge, and using silence as a weapon.
